About me

I'm an AI Engineer who finished a B.Tech in Computer Science (AI & ML) with a perfect 10.00 SGPA. I enjoy work that goes from a trained model all the way to something a team uses every day.

During my internships I trained five YOLOv8 models, made them run in parallel on one video stream, and wrapped them in APIs, reports and Docker. I have also worked on the other side of AI: evaluating and writing training data to make LLMs follow instructions better.

Today I work as an AI Engineer at Amrita Hospital, Faridabad, building software and AI solutions that automate hospital workflows. Before that I built production systems at Chanda Enterprises, where approvals, inventory and dashboards had to be correct.

02Projects

Chanda Store Management System Live

A full-stack inventory, procurement and operations platform for materials, suppliers, purchase orders (GRN), critical spares and alerts. Stock is allocated per batch with FIFO, and nothing changes in inventory until the right people approve it. Deployed on Railway for Chanda Enterprises.

  • FastAPI
  • Flask
  • PostgreSQL
  • SQLAlchemy
  • Alembic
  • Docker
  • Railway

Role-based access (admin, supervisor, staff, viewer), JWT login, low-stock and overstock email alerts, Excel/CSV reports, scheduled daily summaries, and seed data with 147 materials, 32 suppliers and 43 GRNs.

Chanda PPC: Production Planning & Control Live

A production-tracking system for Chanda Enterprises. Operators enter route cards, log production operation by operation with FIFO-aware balance tracking, record daily OEE, pass finished goods through two-stage PDI, and manage dispatch, customer schedules and stock shortages.

  • FastAPI
  • PostgreSQL
  • React
  • Tailwind CSS
  • Framer Motion
  • Three.js
  • Docker Compose
  • Railway

Built as a fully separate application from the Store system, with its own database, backend, frontend and login. One docker compose command runs everything locally.

Kitchen Hygiene AI Detection

A monitoring platform that watches kitchen camera feeds and flags hygiene violations in real time. Five YOLOv8m models, trained on Roboflow-annotated data, run in parallel on every frame. Violations are logged to PostgreSQL and exported as Excel compliance reports.

  • Python
  • YOLOv8
  • FastAPI
  • Docker
  • PostgreSQL

Student Attendance System

Face recognition · May 2025

A Flask web app that takes attendance by recognising faces. Haar Cascade finds the face and LBPH identifies the student, while courses, students and records live in SQLite. It cuts attendance from 10 to 15 minutes down to 2 to 3 minutes per class and stops proxy attendance.
